```{r setup}
library(agena.ai)
```

# Installing the local agena.ai API

Everything is installed under `~/.agena.ai/tools`, shared with agena.ai Explorer and any
other local agena.ai client. Nothing is written to the working directory, and git, Java
and Maven are no longer needed — a Java runtime is downloaded along with the API.

```{r}
local_api_install()
local_api_activate_license("1234-ABCD-5678-EFGH")
```

# Checking the licence

```{r}
local_api_license_summary()
```
